applicant.name: Dr. Pieter de Vries
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Warsaw, Cardiology Research Unit

request.purpose: Scientific research on medication use and treatment gaps in routine care.
request.question: What is the mean ACE inhibitor use of patients with hypertension, by sex?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
ACE inhibitor = ATC code starting with C09AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per sex: patients with hypertension and their mean ACE inhibitor, one decimal.

note: allowed purpose, but the question cannot be interpreted from the definitions
